name: r4-q4-stored-text-sweep
description: Fix Q4 (stored-text sweep). Renames: osi-entity-name compares row.name === name strictly, so a BLOB name (a Buffer) is always renamed with a sync_version bump, and an invalid-UTF-8 TEXT name compares as its decoded string (zone 2 'Z\uFFFD', device A2 'V\uFFFD'); the zone rename echoes row.zone_uuid as read. The valve list echoes row.name and `row.x || null` as read (Buffer JSON for the BLOB name, zone name, zone uuid, skip date, clock ack and stale state). Zone create without a timezone splices String((row && row.value) || 'UTC'): an empty-BLOB gateway setting writes ''. System settings answer the stored gateway timezone as read and a module-only PUT with applyToAllZones writes it to the zones as it is (a BLOB stays a BLOB).
